notes:
Summary: Orchid builds an orchestration layer for agent tool-calls and automated refunds across mid-market platforms. Seeking a provider to run low-latency tool-calls (create/update tickets, trigger refunds, escalate to manager queues) with predictable behavior during traffic spikes.

What they told us: 'We need deterministic tool-calls — when an agent hits refund, the flow must complete (or rollback) before UI update; cannot be eventual). Also want audit trail and SSO tie-in.'

Requirements (high level):
- Workloads: agent-assist UI pop, async ticket summarization, synchronous tool-calls to Zendesk + legacy SOAP ticketing + ERP refund API.
- Latency: synchronous tool-calls target p95 < 350ms under normal load, p95 < 750ms acceptable during 5x spikes.
- Throughput: baseline 60 rps for tool-calls, design for bursts to 300 rps for short windows.
- Reliability: deterministic retry/backoff, idempotency keys, end-to-end tracing and linkable audit logs.
- Data controls: EU residency for customer data, retention controls to 90 days for transcripts, and KMS for keys.
- Ops: need canary rollout, automatic fallback to read-only summaries when tool-call capacity constrained.

PoC ask: 2-week technical POC integrating Redwood Dedicated with their staging Zendesk + a stub SOAP adapter. Measure p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens + tool-call success rate.

Commercial: leaning mid-market contract with annual commit; estimated ARR depends on Dedicated sizing. Procurement will require a simple pilot contract + SOC2 addendum.
